question: Who won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2024 for Dogri literature for the book 'Ik Hor Ashwthama'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chaman Arora**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chaman Arora won the **Sahitya Akademi Award 2024** for his work in Dogri literature.
 
• The awarded book, titled **'Ik Hor Ashwthama'**, is a notable contribution to the Dogri literary tradition.
 
• The Sahitya Akademi Award recognizes **exceptional literary works** in 24 Indian languages, including Dogri.
 
• This prestigious award is presented annually by the **Sahitya Akademi, India's National Academy of Letters**.
 
• The award includes a cash prize of **₹1,00,000**, along with a citation and a memento.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sahitya Akademi Award:**

 
 
• Established in **1954**, the award celebrates literary excellence in India's diverse languages.
 
• It is aimed at promoting and preserving **India's rich linguistic heritage**.
 
• The award encompasses genres like novels, poetry, short stories, essays, and plays.
 
• Only works published in the **preceding five years** are eligible for nomination.
 
 
 
• **Dogri Language:**
 
 
• Dogri is one of the **22 scheduled languages** recognized by the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is primarily spoken in the Jammu region of Jammu & Kashmir.
 
• The language is known for its **rich oral tradition** and vibrant folk literature.
 
• Dogri gained official recognition as a scheduled language in **2003**.
 
 
 
• **Literary Significance of 'Ik Hor Ashwthama':**
 
 
• 'Ik Hor Ashwthama' draws inspiration from **Indian mythology**, exploring themes of immortality and human conflict.
 
• The book is celebrated for its **powerful storytelling and unique narrative structure**.
 
• It reflects contemporary societal issues through the lens of Dogri literature.
 
 
 
• **Sahitya Akademi:**
 
 
• The Sahitya Akademi operates under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• It also organizes literary seminars, workshops, and fellowships to promote **literary activities across India**.
